structured.answer: The page says to open an account at Psagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" (5139282). With 10,000 ₪ now, 500 ₪ a month, 10 years and 7%, it says I'd end with about 86,492 ₪ in today's money. But it's not a deposit and I've never heard of the fund company, so I'd ask my son before doing anything.
